fields.Name: T317 - Scheduling Job Pause Resume Toggle
fields.Description: Tests ToggleJobStatus (updateJobStatus) — an in-place operational state mutation on the card, distinct from any form save/edit round-trip test.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the 'Scheduling' application, then open its 'Jobs' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. On a job card footer there is a 'Pause' or 'Resume' button (pause/play icon). Click it on one job and verify the job responds: an 'Active' job's status chip changes to 'Paused' and its button relabels to 'Resume' (or vice-versa). This is a real state round-trip. If NO job cards exist, seeing the empty state ('Create your first scheduled job') is acceptable instead. Toggling it back to the original state afterward is a bonus.

judgeValidationCriteria: A job card footer shows a Pause/Resume button, OR a valid empty-state if no jobs exist
Clicking Pause/Resume flips that job's status chip (Active<->Paused) and relabels the button accordingly
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
